system.description:
Instruments are a step up from simple Probes. They might be designed to accomplish specific tasks. For example, a Droid with a hypodermic syringe as its sole Appendage can use the syringe for its intended purpose, but otherwise can only push objects with it.

A few Instruments are designed to clamp, and can thus hold objects, but they are generally delicate. A Droid using an instrument of this nature has a Carrying Capacity as if its Strength score were one-quarter of its actual value.
